methodology.strategy_type: Inferred from scraped pastAdvices legs (BUY CE/PE only).
methodology.moneyness: Strike vs Nifty OPEN on trade date (±0.5% ATM, 0.5–1.5% near-OTM, >1.5% far-OTM).
methodology.regime: Bull/bear/sideways from Nifty daily close-to-close return (±0.4% thresholds).
methodology.trend: Compares CE/PE PnL on up-days vs down-days; cross-checked with exit family.
methodology.not_stratzy_copy: Bullets are research-generated; Stratzy marketing "about" text is not used.

families.title: Proprietary entry signals
families.subtitle: Unique signal picks CE vs PE and strike. Exit rules vary.

families.title: GRID exit
families.subtitle: Scale in/out at premium grid levels instead of a single stop.

families.title: Trailing stop loss (TSL)
families.subtitle: Trail stop as premium rises — ride momentum bursts.

families.title: Fixed stop loss
families.subtitle: Hard % cap on loss — exit when premium drops X%.

families.title: Fixed risk-reward
families.subtitle: Target fixed multiple of risk (RR 1:2 or 1:3).

families.title: Partial target
families.subtitle: Book partial profits early, trail the remainder.
